description: Source code for a custom document loader node in a workflow, implementing the INode interface, with methods for initializing and executing JavaScript code to load documents or text.

classes.name: CustomDocumentLoader_DocumentLoaders
classes.description: Implements a custom document loader node with configurable JavaScript execution for loading documents or text.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the node with label, name, version, description, type, icon, category, inputs, and outputs.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Executes the JavaScript function provided in the node's inputs within a sandbox, processes the response based on output type, and handles errors.
